intro: Advising, asking, needing and forbidding: when another person must act, you use «que» and the subjunctive.
p.te aconsejo que.consejo: It is the softest formula. The next verb goes in the subjunctive: «te aconsejo que descanses».
p.te recomiendo que.consejo: It sounds friendly and works for restaurants, books and trips: «te recomiendo que pruebes esto».
p.te pido que.consejo: It is a request, not an order. Without «te» it would be: «pido que», more formal.
p.te sugiero que.consejo: «Sugerir» changes e to ie: «sugiero», and in the subjunctive «sugieras».
p.es mejor que.consejo: It needs no person before it: «es mejor que hables con él». Always with the subjunctive.
p.necesito que.consejo: If you do it, infinitive: «necesito descansar». If someone else does it, «que» and the subjunctive.
p.te prohíbo que.consejo: The accent in «prohíbo» breaks the diphthong: «pro-Í-bo». It is a strong order.
p.dile que.consejo: With the subjunctive it passes an order; with the indicative, a fact: «dile que venga» or «dile que viene».
p.agotado.consejo: For a woman: «agotada». It is stronger than «cansado».
p.apagar.consejo: Before e it is written «gu»: «apague». The opposite is «encender».
p.unos días libres.consejo: «Libre» does not change for man or woman. «Tomarse unos días libres» means taking a short break.
b1.texto:
When you want **another person** to do something, you use **que + subjunctive** after advice, a request, a need or an order:

- **Te aconsejo que** descanses.
- **Te pido que** me ayudes.
- **Necesito que** vengas.
- **Es mejor que** lo hagas hoy.

If the person who needs and the one who acts are the **same**, use the infinitive: **necesito descansar**.

With **decir** there are two meanings: **dice que viene** is a fact; **dice que vengas** is an order passed to another person.
b2.f0.texto: I am exhausted because I sleep few hours.
b2.f1.texto: I advise you to take a few days off.
b2.f2.texto: My boss asks me to work on Saturdays.
b2.f3.texto: Tell him you cannot work on Saturdays.
b2.f4.texto: It is better that you talk to him.
b2.f5.texto: My doctor says I should switch my phone off at night.
b2.f6.texto: I also recommend that you go out for a walk.
b2.f7.texto: Then I ask you to help me with the report.
b4.texto:
These verbs want to **influence** another person and ask for **que + subjunctive**:

- **aconsejar**, **recomendar**, **sugerir** → advice.
- **pedir**, **necesitar** → a request or a need.
- **ordenar**, **prohibir** → an order.
- **permitir**, **dejar** → permission.

The pronoun says who it is aimed at: **te** aconsejo, **le** pido, **me** prohíbe.

If the one who asks and the one who acts are the same person, use the **infinitive**: necesito **descansar**. With advice and permission it is also possible: te aconsejo **descansar**.

Other ways to advise: **lo mejor es que** + subjunctive, **¿por qué no…?** and **deberías** + infinitive.
b4.e0.texto: I recommend that you try the fish.
b4.e1.texto: My sister asks me to switch off the light.
b4.e2.texto: I forbid you to go out without a coat.
b5.f0.texto: Pablo arrives at the cabin with a tired back and red eyes.
b5.f1.texto: A stony path climbs between the pines to the wooden door.
b5.f2.texto: The mountain air smells of resin and wet earth.
b5.f3.texto: Inside, a stone fireplace keeps warm ashes.
b5.f4.texto: Pablo switches off his phone and leaves it inside a drawer.
b5.f5.texto: The silence fills the house like a thick blanket.
b5.f6.texto: Through the window you can see a still lake of a dark green colour.
b5.f7.texto: A bird sings on a branch and breaks the calm for an instant.
b5.f8.texto: Pablo sits on the porch with a cup of tea between his hands.
b5.f9.texto: That night he sleeps eight hours straight under a huge moon.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Well done! Advice to another person asks for «que» and the subjunctive.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Descansas» is the ordinary present, with no advice.
b6.o2.refuerzo: After «que» you need a conjugated verb.
b6.pregunta: You advise Pablo to rest. What is missing?
b7.o0.refuerzo: That's it! With the subjunctive, «decir» passes an order.
b7.o1.refuerzo: That would be «dice que viene», with the indicative.
b7.o2.refuerzo: That would give a fact; the subjunctive gives an order.
b7.pregunta: «Dice que vengas.» What does it mean?
b8.o0.refuerzo: That asks another person to rest. Here it is you.
b8.o1.refuerzo: «Descanso» is conjugated and here the infinitive is needed.
b8.pregunta: You are the one who needs to rest. What is missing?
b9.frase: Es mejor que hables con tu jefe
b9.traduccion: It is better that you talk to your boss
b10.o2.refuerzo: «Pido» is a request, not a ban.
b11.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «I advise you to rest» (tú).
b12.frase: Mi jefe me pide que ____ los sábados.
b12.o0.refuerzo: «Trabajo» is the ordinary present. After «pide que» comes the subjunctive.
b12.o1.refuerzo: Well done! It is a request: «que» and the subjunctive.
b12.o2.refuerzo: The infinitive does not follow «que» in a request.
b12.pregunta: Your boss asks you to work. What is missing?
p.pocas.consejo: The c sounds k before a: «PO-kas». It agrees with the noun: «pocas horas», «pocos días».
p.tomes.consejo: Subjunctive of «tomar». «Tomarse unos días» means to take some days off, like a short holiday.
p.trabaje.consejo: Subjunctive of «trabajar». The j sounds h: «tra-BA-he». The a of «trabaja» becomes e.
p.apague.consejo: Subjunctive of «apagar». The «gu» keeps the g sound; the u is silent: «a-PA-ge».
p.ayudes.consejo: Subjunctive of «ayudar» for tú. The y sounds as in «yo»: «a-YU-des».
p.pruebes.consejo: Subjunctive of «probar». The o becomes ue: «pruebo», «pruebes». It also means to taste food.
p.cabaña.consejo: The ñ sounds ny: «ka-BA-nya». It is a small wooden house in the mountains or countryside.
p.rojos.consejo: The initial r sounds strong and the j sounds h: «RRO-hos». The feminine is «rojas».
p.resina.consejo: The initial r sounds strong: «rre-SI-na». Pine trees give resin, and it smells strongly.
p.chimenea.consejo: The ch sounds like in «chocolate». Two strong vowels in a row: «ne-a» are separate syllables.
p.piedra.consejo: The ie forms one syllable: «PYE-dra». Something «de piedra» is made of stone.
p.cenizas.consejo: The c and the z both sound th: «the-NI-thas». It is almost always plural: «las cenizas».
p.tibias.consejo: The ia forms one syllable: «TI-byas». It is a soft warmth: not cold, not hot. Singular: «tibia».
p.apaga.consejo: Present of «apagar». Before e it becomes «apague», with «gu» to keep the g sound.
p.cajón.consejo: The j sounds h and the accent is on the last syllable: «ka-HON». The plural is «cajones».
p.espesa.consejo: Feminine of «espeso». It is used for a blanket, a fog, a soup or a forest.
p.lago.consejo: Do not confuse it with «largo» (long). It is masculine: «el lago», even if it ends in -o.
p.quieto.consejo: The qu sounds k and ie is one syllable: «KYE-to». The feminine is «quieta».
p.rompe.consejo: The initial r sounds strong: «RROM-pe». You can break an object or a silence: «romper el silencio».
p.instante.consejo: It is a very short moment. «Un instante» is also used to ask someone to wait a moment.
p.porche.consejo: The ch sounds like in «chocolate»: «POR-che». It is the covered area at a house entrance.
p.seguidas.consejo: The «gui» sounds «gi», with a silent u: «se-GI-das». «Ocho horas seguidas» is eight hours without stopping.
p.luna.consejo: It is feminine: «la luna». «Luna llena» is a full moon. The sun is «el sol», masculine.
p.descanses.consejo: Subjunctive of «descansar» for tú. The a of «descansas» becomes e: «que descanses».
